children.label: b
children.prompt: Use the quadratic formula to show $AC$ has length $(3\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{7})\,\mathrm{cm}$ or $(3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{7})\,\mathrm{cm}$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Indicate on the diagram the other possible position of point $C$.

answer.short: Place the other $C$ between $A$ and the original $C$, with $AC=(3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{7})\,\mathrm{cm}$, and join it to $B$.
answer.worked: Both positions lie on the ray from $A$ through the original $C$. The nearer position has $AC=(3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{7})\,\mathrm{cm}$. Join this point to $B$; its distance from $B$ is also $4\,\mathrm{cm}$.
